messages:
priya: Kicking off the compact change window plan for API/runtime/console/router. Window 23:00-23:30 PT. Pin map: api=v2.1.4, runtime=3.0.0-rc2 (canary), console=main, router=1.5.3. Canary traffic 5% to runtime canary. Release notes gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/release-1734567 :spiral_note_pad:
ownen: Quick q — when do we pin/unpin the router? We need router pin before traffic shift from API so old runtime routes don't get mixed in. Can we do pin at t+5?
priya: plan is: router pin at T+2m, api pin at T+4m, start traffic shift at T+6m. Unpin after 30m stable or explicit rollback.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] queued rollout at 1734567220 for services: api/runtime/console/router. Canary set to 5%. Autoscale warmup policy = enabled. See /deploy status: https://deploy/redwood/1734567001
kevin: Note: runtime rc2 has a known kv-eviction sensitivity on long sequences. Recommend running a warmup job on a subset of nodes before shift and enable KV cache prefill. Example job:```kubectl exec -n runtime warmup-job -- /bin/sh -c "python tools/prefill_kv.py --models small,medium --prefix-samples 1000"```
maya: rollback heuristics proposal: if error rate (5xx) > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 3m -> automatic rollback to previous pinned variants. Also manual rollback triggers: any customer-facing regression reported by CS with P0 tag.
sre-oncall: Agree with metrics thresholds. Add saturation check: GPU memory GC thrash > 30% for > 2m -> pause rollout and hold canary. Also add a 3rd check for queue/backlog spike: request_queue_length > 500 sustained -> fast-fail shift.
ownen: For routing, make sure header-swap keys are present: `x-rw-variant` and `x-rw-canary`. We'll use header-based steering to avoid global cookie sticky issues.
priya: Good call. I'll add those to the release notes. Also note: console changes are UI-only toggles; they don't require rollback unless API contract fails.
kevin: Small nit: when unpinning, do a staggered unpin (router -> api -> runtime) to avoid transient mismatches. 30s between unpins.
priya: Agreed. Stagger unpin: router, api, runtime. Console can unpin last.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight checks running: schema-compat, config-lock, canary-alloc. Current status: schema-compat=PASS, config-lock=PASS, canary-alloc=OK, warmup=IN_PROGRESS. Logs: https://logs/redwood/1734567001/warmup
sre-oncall: If warmup fails, hold rollout and notify #eng-oncall. We'll need a manual rollback group if hold persists > 15m.
maya: Add an explicit smoke eval set: `smoke/basic-generation` and `smoke/kv-cache-hitrate`. If hitrate drops by > 10% in canary -> rollback.
priya: I'll attach smoke eval ids to the deploy preflight. Also adding `--eviction-safe-mode=true` to runtime args during canary.
kevin: One more: run deploy with `--max-in-flight=2` for router to limit simultaneous shard transitions.
priya: Ok final checklist summarized in gist and ops checklist. If everyone is good I will kick off at T+0.5m. :thumbsup:
ownen: +1 from me, will watch routing logs.
sre-oncall: I'll be monitoring infra and will escalate at threshold.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout started at 1734567240. Canary subset = runtime-nodepool-canary-01..04. Notifying on-call channels.
kevin: Warmup finished on canary nodes, KV hitrate stable at +2% baseline. Proceed.
maya: Holding canary at 5% for 10m window per plan, running smoke evals.
priya: If smoke evals pass at +10m and metrics stable, we proceed to 50% ramp then 100% per policy. If any automated check trips, rollback will happen and pins remain.
kevin: Documenting rollback command: `deployctl rollback --to=runtime@3.0.0 --services=runtime,api,router` (authorized: deploy->sre lead or eng-release).
sre-oncall: Noted. Contact list in ops doc is live.
priya: Thanks everyone. I'll post a post-release note after the window.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary smoke evals completed at 1734567340: smoke/basic-generation=PASS, smoke/kv-cache-hitrate=PASS. Holding for final 2m then ramp per policy.
ownen: watching router headers and sticky sessions. No anomalies so far.
priya: final: rolling to 50% now. Stay ready for quick rollback command. :eyes:
